title: 第42章 乔迁
content_zh:
第42章 乔迁-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

上一章

存书签

下一章

接下来的几天，日子过得格外风平浪静。

吴姜一边帮着老妈收拾搬家的东西，一边抽空练习画符、稳固修为。念念则乖乖待在聚灵吊坠里修炼养魂术，偶尔被放出来，就缠着吴姜看动画片，一家人的生活平淡又温馨。

转眼又是一个周末，这天阳光正好，也是吴姜正式搬家的日子。

吴时安今天也没去店里，留在家里帮忙，还有两个凑热闹的就是李月芽和她妈妈周素兰了。

王雅琴和周素兰是亲密的闺蜜加牌友，吴姜要搬家的消息，她早就在打麻将的时候，有意无意的炫耀过了。

而李月芽，还是从她妈妈那里得知了吴姜要搬家的消息，晚上就急吼吼的从学校回来了，还在微信里对着吴姜一顿的埋怨加输出。

其实也没多少要搬的东西，早几天，能拿过去的，就全都拿过去了。

大家今天过来，主要是为了烘托乔迁之喜的气氛。

就在众人在新房子里说说笑笑、忙得不亦乐乎的时候，门铃响了，李月芽离门口最近，已经跑着过去开门了。

“咦，阮大哥，秦姐姐。”

门口的正是阮柏云和秦汐夫妇，手里拎着大包小包的东西，正笑吟吟的看着李月芽。

“是芽芽啊，好久不见了，还是这么漂亮！”

李月芽被秦汐夸得脸颊微红，有些不好意思，连忙侧身将两人请进了屋里。

“小姜，恭喜啊，乔迁之喜！”阮柏云一进门，就笑着走上前，拍了拍吴姜的肩膀，“我和你姐听说你今天搬新家，特意过来热闹热闹。”

吴姜连忙上前道谢，热情地将阮柏云和秦汐让到沙发上坐下，李月芽已经去泡茶了。

吴时安和王雅琴还是第一次见到念念的爸妈，吴姜连忙上前，给双方还有周姨正式做了一个介绍。

吴时安和王雅琴连忙上前招呼，两家人这还是第一次正式见面，却没有丝毫生疏感。

阮柏云夫妇谈吐得体，待人谦和，吴时安夫妇也热情实在，几人围坐在一起，聊得十分投机。

吴姜这次搬家，也没准备什么仪式，也就没有通知很多的人。

Chapter 42 Moving-"The City God is my ancestor, it turns out that I am the Nth generation of gods"

The next few days passed extremely calmly.

While Wu Jiang was helping his mother pack the moving things, he also found time to practice drawing talismans and consolidate his cultivation.Nian Nian obediently stayed in the Soul Gathering Pendant to practice soul-nurturing skills. When she was occasionally released, she would pester Wu Jiang to watch cartoons. The family's life was dull and warm.

In the blink of an eye, it was another weekend, the sun was just right, and it was also the day Wu Jiang officially moved.

Wu Shi'an didn't go to the store today and stayed at home to help. The other two people joining in the fun were Li Yueya and her mother Zhou Sulan.

Wang Yaqin and Zhou Sulan were close best friends and poker friends. She had already shown off the news that Wu Jiang was moving, intentionally or unintentionally, while playing mahjong.

As for Li Yueya, she still learned from her mother that Wu Jiang was moving. She came back from school in a hurry at night and complained to Wu Jiang on WeChat.

In fact, there weren't many things to move. In the past few days, everything that could be carried was taken.

Everyone came here today mainly to heighten the atmosphere of housewarming.

Just when everyone was chatting, laughing and busy in the new house, the doorbell rang. Li Yueya was closest to the door and had already ran over to open the door.

"Hey, Brother Ruan, Sister Qin."

It was Ruan Boyun and Qin tide who were at the door, carrying large and small bags of things in their hands and looking at Li Yueya with a smile.

"It's Ya Ya, I haven't seen you for a long time, but you're still so beautiful!"

Li Yueya's cheeks turned slightly red after being praised by Qin tide, and she felt a little embarrassed. She quickly turned sideways and invited the two of them into the room.

"Xiao Jiang, congratulations on your new housewarming!" As soon as Ruan Boyun entered the door, he walked forward with a smile and patted Wu Jiang on the shoulder, "Your sister and I heard that you moved to a new house today, so we came here to make it fun."

Wu Jiang quickly stepped forward to thank him, and enthusiastically asked Ruan Boyun and Qin tide to sit down on the sofa. Li Yueya had already gone to make tea.

This was the first time for Wu Shi'an and Wang Yaqin to meet Niannian's parents. Wu Jiang quickly stepped forward and formally introduced both parties and Aunt Zhou.

Wu Shi'an and Wang Yaqin hurriedly came forward to greet them. This was the first time the two families had officially met, but they didn't feel unfamiliar at all.

Ruan Boyun and his wife were well-spoken and courteous, and Wu Shi'an and his wife were also enthusiastic and down-to-earth. They sat around and had a very interesting chat.

Wu Jiang didn't prepare any ceremony for moving this time, so he didn't notify many people.
